posts.subject: Improvements for Dream
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dream,

Recently, I have been more and more determined and insistent as to how Dream can improve as a community as I start to realise how important this community is to me. We are a great community and everyone here has a valued place and we all want to have fun whilst being on Dream, playing on Dream and socializing on Dream.However, I feel like as though we are in need of some improvements and changes so that everyone has the BEST time playing on Dream as much as possible. 😄 [dgrün*] [right*] [right*]


Below, I have made a list of possible improvements that Dream could make, I am aware that this may be knife-sided but please understand that Knife is the server I play the most and I can only think of improvements on things that I understand well. Players and admins alike, please comment down below if you have anymore suggestions or advice we can pick up in order to be the best we can be 👍 👍

WARNING: SMALL WALLS OF TEXT INCOMING.


General Improvements:

  • Rank points decay (slowly losing your ranked points if you are inactive for a certain period of time, for example, losing 100 points each day after 1 week of inactivity) - this needs to be implemented as many players that have played on our servers and got a high !top rank, leave and hardly play again will still be in the top spots but this is unfair as players of a lower rank need to try harder in order to get to a top 10 or top 100 - I understand that this may not be applicable to every server (for example, bhop) but for knife, this is mandatory. [ddos1]
  • Find new maps to implement every month AT LEAST - This is quite straightforward, people get bored of playing the same maps over and over again (I understand that some players like certain maps) but new is always good, finding new maps so that players can play on consistently is crucial. 👍
  • Updating maps on admin menu - Only the old maps are on the system, I think that it is needed that the new ones are available too so that admins can pick the map that the player wants when a map change is needed. [dumm**]
  • Look for more players/people that have special skills such as scripters, coders, map designers etc. 😄 [suchten*]
  • Remove all 1_hp and ka maps - It is clearly labelled 35_hp knifing, not 1_hp or 100_hp. [dumm**] [dumm**]
  • Advertise the community - right now, players are joining because they are bored of MM, but why not make people buy CS:GO for the community servers, not just competitive shooting - maybe setting up special events (such as x2 stamm) or implementing giveaways (credits) or sponsoring small companies or gaming companies that can help us be more well known and progress. [suchten*]
  • New innovations - kind of combines with advertising - what makes Dream so special? Has the servers got something unique to it so that people would want to go Dream for that 'special thing'? 😄
  • Devise a way so that players who are new to the servers KNOW THE RULES 100% [dieregeln*] . Not will this only make admin's job easy (less warnings) but actually so that, other players won't be so sick and tired of new players breaking rules - We can maybe devise a way of making it so that players actually agree to the 'Terms and Conditions' of the server so they have no excuse when they break a rule and get kicked. [neinnein*]
  • Focus Dream's attention to popular servers - I mean honestly, the most active servers are Knife and Jail, some may argue TTT and Minigames but honestly, if we can have more active admins on populated servers, then things will go a lot more smoothly. [dieregeln*] 👍
  • Update and refresh round-end music every month AT LEAST - people just get tired of the same songs repeating over and over again, so if we could maybe do a monthly music suggestions post of what music players like and we can implement new ones while getting rid of the old, unwanted ones (we can maybe do it so that repeated songs that keep getting suggested gets a permanent place on the song list). 👍
  • Find a way to stop G-Hits on knife server [dumm**] , honestly, those times are so annoying. You click, see the motion and hear the sound of the player getting stabbed but they don't die. I understand that maybe some other servers have this problem too but if we spend the time into maybe trying to fix this problem, then this will create a unique point as to why people should come Dream.
  • Invest more time in finding more plugins that will improve/help/benefit the servers - for example, automatically moving someone to spectators if they are AFK [bb*] , many people want a knife and since they are playing on a knife server, some players without knives can feel down and sad [||] 🙁 , so finding a plugin where you can !takeknife from people or even dropping the knives and able to pick them up will be fun, find cool thing such as a knife distance recorder (showing the distance that you knifed someone AFTER they die) or maybe new admin plugins (moving people in-game - I saw from other servers that the admins had the power to move players in game and move the admins to places - another version of noclip. This will greatly benefit admins as they can stop people from 2 vs 1 [bananenrules*] or breaking the rules as soon as the admin can see the person trying to). 😄 😄
  • Better and more rewards for players that reach a big milestone, people who reach top 10 on the ranked leaderboards should have more than just a simple message. Maybe changing the name of their colour while using tab or adding a little title (on the scoreboard) of the players - for example "[TOP 1] Doo Doo" - even thought that will never happen. 😏
  • New !shop items! I mean, I love the shop items now and having masks was a cool idea but honestly, we need more and more and more. Update the shop more, include more trails, make more masks, have cooler pets, this will honestly keep people playing more as they feel like "I WANT THAT COOL POOP MASK" [wow] and want to keep playing on the server so they gain more credits.
  • Finally, in my opinion, the key to a successful and big community is effective admins. I suggest admin checks - a high rank of the Dream Team going round and interviewing if admins are active on TS3, Forums and the servers, check if the admins are behaving appropriately and if the community is satisfied with the admin or not. [smoke] 😇 [dieregeln*]

EDIT'1': Disable the fact that you can walk through enemy players please, just encourages 2 vs 1 in tight spaces...
That's it! Again, sorry for the excessive wall of text but I seriously and strongly believe that Dream needs to step the game up. There is new competition on knife alone (new servers, new communities) and in order for us to stand our ground, we need the players to be happy and stay.



Thank you,
Doo Doo

Hey,


first off, thanks @Doo Doo for the list of possible improvements.
Below your list with some annotations on what has already been done and on what could be done in the future.

Zitat von Doo Doo
  • Rank points decay (slowly losing your ranked points if you are inactive for a certain period of time, for example, losing 100 points each day after 1 week of inactivity) - this needs to be implemented as many players that have played on our servers and got a high !top rank, leave and hardly play again will still be in the top spots but this is unfair as players of a lower rank need to try harder in order to get to a top 10 or top 100 - I understand that this may not be applicable to every server (for example, bhop) but for knife, this is mandatory. [ddos1]

    • Not possible as there's no convar included in the plugin that'd allow us to do this - still I found a convar to block people from showing up on the rank top board when they haven't visited the server for a while. -> Set it to 14 days
  • Find new maps to implement every month AT LEAST - This is quite straightforward, people get bored of playing the same maps over and over again (I understand that some players like certain maps) but new is always good, finding new maps so that players can play on consistently is crucial. 👍

    • It's hard for Sky/me to search new maps for all of the servers in a monthly cycle but everyone can help us with that by proposing maps on the forum, just as @ifZ4ne regularily does
  • Updating maps on admin menu - Only the old maps are on the system, I think that it is needed that the new ones are available too so that admins can pick the map that the player wants when a map change is needed. [dumm**]

    • Done [right*]
  • Look for more players/people that have special skills such as scripters, coders, map designers etc. 😄 [suchten*]

    • Unfortunately, this is easier said than done - atm we are looking for scripters but as we got not budget to pay for coders etc. the search could last for a while
  • Remove all 1_hp and ka maps - It is clearly labelled 35_hp knifing, not 1_hp or 100_hp. [dumm**] [dumm**]

    • Removed 1_hp maps + arena maps, except the two maps created for/by Dream as they are essential pieces of community work
  • Advertise the community - right now, players are joining because they are bored of MM, but why not make people buy CS:GO for the community servers, not just competitive shooting - maybe setting up special events (such as x2 stamm) or implementing giveaways (credits) or sponsoring small companies or gaming companies that can help us be more well known and progress. [suchten*]

    • there will be more events (Stamm etc.) in the future
  • New innovations - kind of combines with advertising - what makes Dream so special? Has the servers got something unique to it so that people would want to go Dream for that 'special thing'? 😄

    • We're always trying to improve the servers but it's nearly impossible these days to make your server unique, except by unique scripts but we're currently lacking a coder who could write these scripts
  • Devise a way so that players who are new to the servers KNOW THE RULES 100% [dieregeln*] . Not will this only make admin's job easy (less warnings) but actually so that, other players won't be so sick and tired of new players breaking rules - We can maybe devise a way of making it so that players actually agree to the 'Terms and Conditions' of the server so they have no excuse when they break a rule and get kicked. [neinnein*]

    • An "Accept the rules" button would'nt help much as players would just click it away. It's every players responsibility to read and respect the rules, if they break them it's their own fault even if they didn't read them
  • Focus Dream's attention to popular servers - I mean honestly, the most active servers are Knife and Jail, some may argue TTT and Minigames but honestly, if we can have more active admins on populated servers, then things will go a lot more smoothly. [dieregeln*] 👍

    • We can't force admins to choose any specific server. so that's up to our applicants
  • Update and refresh round-end music every month AT LEAST - people just get tired of the same songs repeating over and over again, so if we could maybe do a monthly music suggestions post of what music players like and we can implement new ones while getting rid of the old, unwanted ones (we can maybe do it so that repeated songs that keep getting suggested gets a permanent place on the song list). 👍

    • Definitely possible - we'll think about that and maybe introduce a 2-3 month cycle of the RES, as it's too much of an effort to do it once a month and we want to keep some of the "classic" sounds
  • Find a way to stop G-Hits on knife server [dumm**] , honestly, those times are so annoying. You click, see the motion and hear the sound of the player getting stabbed but they don't die. I understand that maybe some other servers have this problem too but if we spend the time into maybe trying to fix this problem, then this will create a unique point as to why people should come Dream.

    • Hard to fix, the server is already running on 128tick - atm I can't think of a way to improve it further
  • Invest more time in finding more plugins that will improve/help/benefit the servers - for example, automatically moving someone to spectators if they are AFK [bb*] , many people want a knife and since they are playing on a knife server, some players without knives can feel down and sad [||] 🙁 , so finding a plugin where you can !takeknife from people or even dropping the knives and able to pick them up will be fun, find cool thing such as a knife distance recorder (showing the distance that you knifed someone AFTER they die) or maybe new admin plugins (moving people in-game - I saw from other servers that the admins had the power to move players in game and move the admins to places - another version of noclip. This will greatly benefit admins as they can stop people from 2 vs 1 [bananenrules*] or breaking the rules as soon as the admin can see the person trying to). 😄 😄

    • We'll look into that - again it is possible for everyone to help us by suggesting plugins like that
  • Better and more rewards for players that reach a big milestone, people who reach top 10 on the ranked leaderboards should have more than just a simple message. Maybe changing the name of their colour while using tab or adding a little title (on the scoreboard) of the players - for example "[TOP 1] Doo Doo" - even thought that will never happen. 😏

    • Again hard to implement, as we can't change the rank plugin
  • New !shop items! I mean, I love the shop items now and having masks was a cool idea but honestly, we need more and more and more. Update the shop more, include more trails, make more masks, have cooler pets, this will honestly keep people playing more as they feel like "I WANT THAT COOL POOP MASK" [wow] and want to keep playing on the server so they gain more credits.

    • Atm the modelling is done by @Sky - I can't really speak for him but as soon as he has the time to create new models, I'm sure he'll do so
  • Finally, in my opinion, the key to a successful and big community is effective admins. I suggest admin checks - a high rank of the Dream Team going round and interviewing if admins are active on TS3, Forums and the servers, check if the admins are behaving appropriately and if the community is satisfied with the admin or not. [smoke] 😇 [dieregeln*]

    • We try to keep in touch with our team regularily but we'll try and work on that as well

EDIT'1': Disable the fact that you can walk through enemy players please, just encourages 2 vs 1 in tight spaces...
That's it! Again, sorry for the excessive wall of text but I seriously and strongly believe that Dream needs to step the game up. There is new competition on knife alone (new servers, new communities) and in order for us to stand our ground, we need the players to be happy and stay.
